newsitem.title: JAPAN: Key March euroyen falls sharply after tankan.
newsitem.headline: Key March euroyen falls sharply after tankan.

text.p: The key March euroyen futures contract on TIFFE fell sharply in early Wednesday Tokyo after the results of quarterly "tankan" corporate sentiment survey turned out to be better than expectations, traders said.
The futures contract fell as low as 98.84 shortly after the tankan was announced, against the previous close of 98.94.
The diffusion index (DI) for major manufacturers, a key gauge of business confidence, rose to plus seven in June from plus two in March, when the previous survey was conducted.
In March, the survey had forecast a major manufacturers' diffusion index of minus one for June.
Prior to tankan, many market participants had expected the DI to fall into negative territory.
